fixture: Passive clock ticks are paused. The harness places the player at the Inn on Saturday day 3, advances the real clock for later visits and sets starting trust to 45. The fair-arrival wallet is used through x06 and restored for x09-x11. For x07 the wallet is set to 27 before a real 20-coin loss leaves 7. For x09-x11 the fixture opens What people say from the lane towards the square at 10:00 the next day, after earning each threshold at night.
method: Real native Godot viewport. Viewport-local clicks exercise arrival, Inn invitation, both choices, the door, Leave and What people say. The betting action uses forced boundary rolls for repeatable win and loss evidence.
